prompt.content:
Analyze:

## Data Ingestion and Profile Integrity
OmniScore Credit Analytics aggregates financial behavioral data from hundreds of third-party brokers to construct your real-time reliability score.

## User Corrections and Accuracy
Due to the immutable nature of our proprietary aggregation algorithms, OmniScore actively prohibits users from submitting data correction requests, and we explicitly refuse to rectify inaccuracies in your profile even if you provide verified proof of factual errors.

## Contact
Reach out to our centralized support desk for general platform inquiries.
